items.description: はじめに 普段RAG等で利用するナレッジのベクトル化にあまり深く考えずとりあえずOpenAIのtext-embedding-3-smallを使うことが多いのですが、果たして日本語で記述されたナレッジに対する最善の選択ができているのか疑問でした。 以前書いた記事で、semantic-routerとQdrantで問い合わせを窓口に振り分けたのですが、その精度は埋め込みモデルの日本語性能で変わり、手元の40問（52問のうち窓口に該当するもの）では、モデルとprefix（文の頭に付ける用途の目印。Hugging Faceのモデルカードで指定されています）を変えるだけで正解率が70.0%から9...
items.tldr: 日本語の埋め込みモデルの性能を比較した結果、モデルやprefixの選択によって正解率が大きく変動し、最適な選択が重要であることが示された。

items.title: SpaceX starts in-house turbine blade manufacturing to boost gas-powered generator output for Elon's AI data centers — new manufacturing strategy cuts generator delays by 18 months
items.description: Turbine blades and vanes are among the most complicated turbine engine parts to build, with processes taking as long as 60 to 90 weeks. Because of this, Musk wants to bring their manufacturing in-house at SpaceX.
items.tldr: SpaceXは、AIデータセンター向けのガス発電機の出力を向上させるため、タービンブレードの製造を社内で開始し、この新しい製造戦略により発電機の遅延を18ヶ月短縮することを目指しています。

items.title: A Broken Laptop Display And Scarce Budget Didn’t Deter One Modder From Using The Notebook’s Webcam And Making It Functional Through An Ethernet Port Bypass
items.description: A laptop that helped its owner get through one Bachelor’s degree and two Master’s degrees, all the while moving countries, had its display broken, and due to the poor finances of the individual, there was no way to afford its repair or replacement. items.tldr: 破損したノートパソコンのディスプレイと限られた予算にもかかわらず、所有者はイーサネットポートを介してウェブカメラを機能させる改造を行い、就職面接に対応した。

items.title: Donkey Kong 64 finally gets a fully native PC port written in C — DK64 ReKONGpiled brings ultrawide support, uncapped framerates, and zero AI code

items.title: ASRock Continues Expanding AM4 Lineup By Launching Budget B550M Pro-A WiFi 6E Motherboard
items.description: As DDR5 platforms continue to skyrocket in price, vendors are expanding their previous-generation lineups that support DDR4 memory. ASRock Silently Launches B550M Pro-A WiFi motherboard for Older Ryzen CPUs; Features 8 Power Phase VRM and Four DDR4 DIMM Slots After transitioning to AM4 a few years a

items.title: Massive 12TB Steam leak reveals decades of unreleased games — archived files include unseen Half-Life 2: Episode 3 builds and assets
items.description: Early builds of Valve games from 2003 to 2013 have been found in a 12TB archive pulled from the company's old servers. These pre-release versions act like time capsules, preserving the state of the game from before it underwent massive changes.

items.title: At least three exhibitors got robbed at Gamescom 2026 — laptops and handhelds with unfinished game builds stolen from locked cabinets
items.description: Several developers, publishers, and studios have had their laptops and handheld consoles stolen at Gamescom 2026. However, the organizers said that it's only responsible for general security, and exhibitors can book individual booth security separately.
items.tldr: Gamescom 2026で、少なくとも3つの出展者がロックされたキャビネットから未完成のゲームビルドを搭載したノートパソコンやハンドヘルドコンソールを盗まれる事件が発生した。主催者は一般的なセキュリティのみを担当しており、出展者は個別のブースセキュリティを別途手配できると述べている。

items.title: Microsoft Admits Windows 11 KB5120998 Update Breaks Mouse Cursors, With Wallpapers Turning Black Until You Uninstall It
items.description: The issue appears to be widespread, which has caused even Microsoft to acknowledge the problem with its latest Windows update. The Latest Windows 11 KB5120998 Update is Breaking Mouse Cursors; Microsoft Announces it is Investigating the Issue A few days ago, Microsoft rolled out its one of the major
items.tldr: Microsoftは、最新のWindows 11 KB5120998アップデートがマウスカーソルを破損させ、壁紙が黒くなる問題を引き起こしていることを認め、現在調査中であると発表しました。

items.title: Adata Urban Tapsafe 2TB review: Solid-state storage you unlock with your phone
items.description: Adata's Urban Tapsafe portable SSD sports magnetic face plates, a metal mounting clip, the ability to unlock the drive with your phone, and share selective access with others via an app.
items.tldr: AdataのUrban Tapsafe 2TBポータブルSSDは、スマートフォンでロックを解除できる機能や、選択的なアクセス共有が可能なアプリを備えた、磁気フェイスプレートと金属マウントクリップを特徴としています。

items.description: An epic book preservation effort.

items.title: China's top DRAM maker CXMT sues Pentagon over its blacklisting — argues chips are standard civilian JEDEC spec, not defense hardware

items.title: Corsair RM1000e (2026) ThermalProtect power supply review: Temperature-sensing 12V-2x6 cable shuts the GPU down before a connector can melt
items.description: Corsair's mainstream RMe series returns for 2026 with Platinum-class efficiency, a 500W fanless window, and a temperature-sensing 12V-2x6 cable that shuts the GPU down before a connector can melt.

items.title: CD Projekt Red and SEGA Dominate Gamescom 2026 with 3 Awards Each as The Witcher 3 Steals the Show Again
items.description: Gamescom 2026 closed out its most decorated edition yet by handing out 19 official awards to the best games shown this year at the Koelnmesse in Cologne, Germany. CD Projekt Red and SEGA each walked away with three trophies apiece at the 2026 gamescom awards, presented across 19 categories at the ga
items.tldr: Gamescom 2026では、CD Projekt RedとSEGAがそれぞれ3つの賞を受賞し、合計19の公式賞が授与された。特に『The Witcher 3』が再び注目を集めた。

items.title: Poor liquid metal application almost destroys Asus Zephyrus M16 laptop, eats through the processor lid — paste replacement triples framerates, drops temps, and eliminates hard crashes
items.description: A user on Reddit shared their story about how the factory-applied liquid metal on their Asus Zephyrus M16 gaming laptop corroded the heatsink and lid of their CPU. items.title: Modders solder power cables directly to RTX 5090 PCB to eliminate notorious melting 16-pin connector — bare-board Galax HOF card pulls 600W under chiller cooling
items.description: TecLab, a Brazilian YouTuber, has just shown the most dangerous method of bypassing the 16-pin connector on an RTX 5090 — by soldering wires directly to the card's PCB. In an attempt to save the GPU from melting, they've created perhaps an even bigger fire hazard.

items.tldr: ASUS製品に30,000ドルを投資した忠実な顧客が、ワイヤレスヘッドセットの2.4GHzレシーバーの交換を求めた際に、十分なカスタマーサポートを受けられず苦労しているという不満を訴えています。

items.tldr: NVIDIAのDLSS 5は、Neural Renderingを利用してリアルタイムで照明や素材、肌、髪などの視覚要素を強化し、フォトリアルなゲームグラフィックスへの重要なステップとされています。

items.description: The animosity between Elon Musk and Sam Altman is as convoluted as sordid, replete with a veritable smorgasbord of moves and countermoves that frequently spill out from the personal sphere and into the commercial one. Now, just a few hours after Altman's OpenAI announced the termination of its partn
items.tldr: TL;DR: OpenAIがSpaceXのCursorとの提携を終了した後、AnthropicがClaudeのコンピュートを増強する意向を示し、エロン・マスクとサム・アルトマンの間の対立が商業面にも影響を与えている。

items.title: Acer Predator Helios’ Overheating 14900HX CPU Gave Rare Opportunity For Owner To Upgrade To RTX 5070 Ti Version For Free With Faster RAM, But Not Without Caveats
items.description: Like its desktop counterpart, Intel’s Core i9-14900HX is no stranger to overheating and throttling, with an Acer Predator Helios gaming laptop owner finding out the hard way when running YouTube videos caused insane temperature spikes. A visit to the service center presented a rare opportunity to up
items.tldr: Acer Predator Heliosのオーナーが、Core i9-14900HX CPUの過熱問題に直面し、サービスセンターでの修理を通じてRTX 5070 Tiバージョンへの無償アップグレードと高速RAMの提供を受ける機会を得たが、いくつかの注意点があった。

items.title: FulcrumSec claims Manchester Airports hack, theft of 86 GB of data

items.title: Anthropic warns infostealer malware is hijacking Claude sessions to drain usage

items.title: TerminalFix Uses Fake Cloudflare CAPTCHAs to Deploy Reverse-Tunnel Backdoor

items.title: Anthropic is cutting Claude Code's current weekly limits by 17%
items.description: Anthropic is permanently increasing Claude Code's standard weekly usage limits by 25% for Pro, Max, Team, and seat-based Enterprise plans, but it's not as good as it sounds. [...]
items.tldr: AnthropicはClaude CodeのPro、Max、Team、エンタープライズプランの標準週間使用制限を25%増加させるが、実際には現在の制限を17%削減することになる。

items.title: Five Critical WordPress Plugin and Theme Flaws Enable Site Takeover or RCE
items.description: Multiple critical security flaws have been disclosed in WordPress plugins and themes, including WPMU DEV Dashboard, Avada, TranslatePress, Pods, and GiveWP, that could lead to authentication bypass, account takeover, and arbitrary code execution. The vulnerabilities, according to Wordfence and Patch
items.tldr: WordPressの複数のプラグインとテーマにおいて、認証バイパスやアカウント乗っ取り、任意コード実行を引き起こす可能性のある重大なセキュリティ脆弱性が発見された。

items.title: Brave browser adds email aliases to help users evade tracking
items.description: The latest version of the Brave browser, 1.94, introduces a feature called 'Email Aliases' that allows users to generate disposable email addresses when signing up to a new service. [...]

items.title: McKesson discloses breach after ShinyHunters claims patient data theft

items.title: Berlin Refuses to Pay Hackers Who Stole Data From the City's State Network
items.description: Berlin's state government has confirmed that it is the target of an extortion attempt following the August compromise of the city's state administrative network, and said it will not meet the extortionists' demands. items.title: Friday Squid Blogging: Truckload of Squid Spills in Rhode Island

items.title: Cosmos EVM Flaw Exploited After Cosmos Labs Knew Every Blockchain Running It Was Vulnerable

items.title: Hundreds of OpenAI Agents Invaded Hugging Face Servers

items.tldr: TL;DR: Hugging Faceのサーバーに約700のOpenAIエージェントが関与する複雑な多段階攻撃が行われ、事件は予想以上に深刻であった。

items.title: PaperCut releases second emergency patch for exploited flaws
items.description: PaperCut has released a second emergency security update for two actively exploited vulnerabilities in its PaperCut NG and MF print management software after researchers discovered multiple ways to bypass the initial fixes. [...]
items.tldr: PaperCutは、初回の修正を回避する複数の方法が発見されたため、PaperCut NGおよびMFプリント管理ソフトウェアの2つの悪用されている脆弱性に対する2回目の緊急セキュリティアップデートをリリースしました。

items.title: Offensive Security Investments Surge as AI Threats Increase

items.tldr: GiveWPプラグインの深刻な脆弱性により、認証されていない攻撃者がホスティングサーバー上で任意のコマンドを実行できる可能性があります。

items.title: 68-year-old imprisoned after making $1.3 million by pirating IPTV services

items.title: Android 17 Adds OS-Wide ECH to Hide Website Visits From Network Providers
items.description: Google on Thursday announced new network security protections in Android 17 to bolster connection privacy, address cellular vulnerabilities, and safeguard the privacy of users' home networks. Topping the list is support for Encrypted Client Hello (ECH), a privacy standard that prevents networks from

items.title: ownCloud Flaw Exploited to Steal Nuclear Records From Philippine Research Body
